snippet.title: Sakura Taisen - First Battle
snippet.description:
A recording of the first battle of the Dreamcast version Sakura Taisen. I rushed though it, because of the video size limit.

Because of the way I recorded the video, Maria's special attack doesn't display properly.

This video was created for Spirit Armor's Let's Play thread.
